metric.label: Lexical baseline
metric.description: Character n-gram cosine distance. This is a reproducible lexical baseline, not a semantic or faithfulness score.

units.leftText: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life
units.rightText: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands — this is the Word of life.

units.leftText: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);
units.rightText: And this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it and testified to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.

units.leftText: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.
units.rightText: We write these things so that our joy may be complete.

units.leftText: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
units.rightText: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.

units.leftText: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.
units.rightText: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.

units.leftText: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.
units.rightText: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.

units.leftText: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
units.rightText: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

units.leftText: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
units.rightText: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

units.leftText: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
units.rightText: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.

units.leftText: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
units.rightText: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father — Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
leftNotes: 2:1 Greek παρακλητον: Counselor, Helper, Intercessor, Advocate, and Comforter.

units.leftText: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
units.rightText: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
leftNotes: 2:2 “atoning sacrifice” is from the Greek “ιλασμος”, an appeasing, propitiating, or the means of appeasement or propitiation—the sacrifice that turns away God’s wrath because of our sin.

units.leftText: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
units.rightText: By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.

units.leftText: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
units.rightText: If anyone says, “I know Him,” but does not keep His commandments, he is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

units.leftText: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:
units.rightText: But if anyone keeps His word, the love of God has been truly perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him:

units.leftText: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
units.rightText: Whoever claims to abide in Him must walk as Jesus walked.

units.leftText: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
units.rightText: Beloved, I am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old one, which you have had from the beginning. This commandment is the message you have heard.

units.leftText: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.
units.rightText: Then again, I am also writing to you a new commandment, which is true in Him and also in you. For the darkness is fading and the true light is already shining.

units.leftText: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
units.rightText: If anyone claims to be in the light but hates his brother, he is still in the darkness.

units.leftText: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
units.rightText: Whoever loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no cause of stumbling in him.

units.leftText: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
units.rightText: But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness. He does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

units.leftText: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
units.rightText: I am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven through His name.

units.leftText: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning.
units.rightText: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning.

units.leftText: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning.
units.rightText: I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning.

units.leftText: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
units.rightText: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

units.leftText: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
units.rightText: For all that is in the world — the desires of the flesh, the desires of the eyes, and the pride of life — is not from the Father but from the world.

units.leftText: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
units.rightText: The world is passing away, along with its desires; but whoever does the will of God remains forever.

units.leftText: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
units.rightText: Children, it is the last hour; and just as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, so now many antichrists have appeared. This is how we know it is the last hour.

units.leftText: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
units.rightText: They went out from us, but they did not belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to us.

units.leftText: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
units.rightText: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
leftNotes: 2:20 Or, “know what is true”, or, “know all things”
rightNotes: 2:20 BYZ and TR and you know all things

units.leftText: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
units.rightText: I have not written to you because you lack knowledge of the truth, but because you have it, and because no lie comes from the truth.

units.leftText: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
units.rightText: Who is the liar, if it is not the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, who denies the Father and the Son.

units.leftText: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
units.rightText: Whoever denies the Son does not have the Father, but whoever confesses the Son has the Father as well.
leftNotes: 2:23 MT omits: He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

units.leftText: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
units.rightText: As for you, let what you have heard from the beginning remain in you. If it does, you will also remain in the Son and in the Father.

units.leftText: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
units.rightText: And this is the promise that He Himself made to us: eternal life.

units.leftText: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
units.rightText: I have written these things to you about those who are trying to deceive you.

units.leftText: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
units.rightText: And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But just as His true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things, so remain in Him as you have been taught.

units.leftText: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
units.rightText: And now, little children, remain in Christ, so that when He appears, we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming.

units.leftText: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
units.rightText: If you know that He is righteous, you also know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him.

units.leftText: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
units.rightText: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.

units.leftText: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
units.rightText: Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.
rightNotes: 3:2 Literally when He appears or when it appears

units.leftText: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
units.rightText: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.
rightNotes: 3:3 Literally just as He is pure

units.leftText: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
units.rightText: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well. Indeed, sin is lawlessness.
rightNotes: 3:4 Or is violation of the Law

units.leftText: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.
units.rightText: But you know that Christ appeared to take away sins, and in Him there is no sin.

units.leftText: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.
units.rightText: No one who remains in Him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has seen Him or known Him.

units.leftText: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
units.rightText: Little children, let no one deceive you: The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.

units.leftText: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
units.rightText: The one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the very start. This is why the Son of God was revealed, to destroy the works of the devil.

units.leftText: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
units.rightText: Anyone born of God refuses to practice sin, because God’s seed abides in him; he cannot go on sinning, because he has been born of God.

units.leftText: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
units.rightText: By this the children of God are distinguished from the children of the devil: Anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is anyone who does not love his brother.

units.leftText: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—
units.rightText: This is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another.

units.leftText: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
units.rightText: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did Cain slay him? Because his own deeds were evil, while those of his brother were righteous.

units.leftText: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
units.rightText: So do not be surprised, brothers, if the world hates you.

units.leftText: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.
units.rightText: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. The one who does not love remains in death.

units.leftText: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
units.rightText: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that eternal life does not reside in a murderer.

units.leftText: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
units.rightText: By this we know what love is: Jesus laid down His life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.

units.leftText: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
units.rightText: If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of God abide in him?

units.leftText: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
units.rightText: Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.

units.leftText: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,
units.rightText: And by this we will know that we belong to the truth, and will assure our hearts in His presence:

units.leftText: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
units.rightText: Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.

units.leftText: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;
units.rightText: Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,

units.leftText: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
units.rightText: and we will receive from Him whatever we ask, because we keep His commandments and do what is pleasing in His sight.

units.leftText: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.
units.rightText: And this is His commandment: that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and we should love one another just as He commanded us.

units.leftText: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
units.rightText: Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him. And by this we know that He remains in us: by the Spirit He has given us.

units.leftText: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
units.rightText: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.

units.leftText: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,
units.rightText: By this you will know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,

units.leftText: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.
units.rightText: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and which is already in the world at this time.
rightNotes: 4:3 BYZ and TR that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh

units.leftText: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
units.rightText: You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.

units.leftText: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
units.rightText: They are of the world. That is why they speak from the world’s perspective, and the world listens to them.

units.leftText: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
units.rightText: We are from God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. That is how we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.

units.leftText: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
units.rightText: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

units.leftText: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
units.rightText: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

units.leftText: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
units.rightText: This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.
leftNotes: 4:9 The phrase “only born” is from the Greek word “μονογενη”, which is sometimes translated “only begotten” or “one and only”.

units.leftText: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
units.rightText: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
leftNotes: 4:10 “atoning sacrifice” is from the Greek “ιλασμος”, an appeasing, propitiating, or the means of appeasement or propitiation—the sacrifice that turns away God’s wrath because of our sin.

units.leftText: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
units.rightText: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

units.leftText: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
units.rightText: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.

units.leftText: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
units.rightText: By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.

units.leftText: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.
units.rightText: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent His Son to be the Savior of the world.

units.leftText: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.
units.rightText: If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.

units.leftText: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
units.rightText: And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.

units.leftText: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.
units.rightText: In this way, love has been perfected among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment; for in this world we are just like Him.

units.leftText: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
units.rightText: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.

units.leftText: We love him, because he first loved us.
units.rightText: We love because He first loved us.
rightNotes: 4:19 BYZ and TR We love Him

units.leftText: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
units.rightText: If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.

units.leftText: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.
units.rightText: And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.

units.leftText: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.
units.rightText: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
rightNotes: 5:1 Literally and everyone loving the One having begotten also loves the one having been begotten from Him.

units.leftText: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
units.rightText: By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep His commandments.

units.leftText: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.
units.rightText: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome,

units.leftText: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
units.rightText: because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.

units.leftText: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
units.rightText: Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.

units.leftText: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
units.rightText: This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ — not by water alone, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies to this, because the Spirit is the truth.

units.leftText: For there are three who testify:
units.rightText: For there are three that testify:
leftNotes: 5:7 Only a few recent manuscripts add “in heaven: the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit; and these three are one. And there are three that testify on earth:”
rightNotes: 5:7 TR and PT three that testify in heaven: The Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit; and these three are one. 8*And there are three that testify on earth:

units.leftText: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.
units.rightText: the Spirit, the water, and the blood — and these three are in agreement.

units.leftText: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.
units.rightText: Even if we accept human testimony, the testimony of God is greater. For this is the testimony that God has given about His Son.

units.leftText: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.
units.rightText: Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony within him; whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given about His Son.

units.leftText: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
units.rightText: And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.

units.leftText: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
units.rightText: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.

units.leftText: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
units.rightText: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
rightNotes: 5:13 BYZ and TR include and that you may believe in the name of the Son of God.

units.leftText: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
units.rightText: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.

units.leftText: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
units.rightText: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we already possess what we have asked of Him.

units.leftText: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.
units.rightText: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying he should ask regarding that sin.

units.leftText: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.
units.rightText: All unrighteousness is sin, yet there is sin that does not lead to death.

units.leftText: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.
units.rightText: We know that anyone born of God does not keep on sinning; the One who was born of God protects him, and the evil one cannot touch him.
rightNotes: 5:18 Or the one who was born of God protects himself or God protects the one born of Him

units.leftText: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
units.rightText: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.

units.leftText: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
units.rightText: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true — in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.

units.leftText: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
units.rightText: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
